request: Create a dashboard for the top 10 products by revenue, save it, and verify that loading the saved dashboard preserves its data and configuration.

User Request: Create a dashboard for the top 10 products by revenue, save it, and verify that loading the saved dashboard preserves its data and configuration.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Top 10 Products by Revenue
Type: bar_chart
Description: Displays the top 10 products based on total revenue generated.
Title: Total Revenue
Type: metric
Description: Displays the total revenue generated by the top 10 products.
Title: Revenue by Product Category
Type: pie_chart
Description: Shows the distribution of revenue among different product categories.
Title: Monthly Revenue Trend
Type: line_chart
Description: Tracks the revenue trend of the top 10 products over the last 12 months.
Title: Units Sold by Product
Type: bar_chart
Description: Displays the number of units sold for each of the top 10 products.
Title: Average Order Value
Type: metric
Description: Shows the average order value for orders containing the top 10 products.
Title: Customer Demographics
Type: table
Description: Displays aggregated customer demographics for purchasers of the top 10 products.
Title: Sales by Region
Type: map
Description: Visualizes sales distribution of the top 10 products across different regions.
Title: Top Suppliers for Products
Type: table
Description: Lists the top suppliers for the products in the top 10 by revenue.
Title: Shipping Performance
Type: metric
Description: Displays average shipping time for orders containing the top 10 products.

sql_queries.title: Top 10 Products by Revenue
sql_queries.description: Displays the top 10 products based on total revenue generated.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Total Revenue
sql_queries.description: Displays the total revenue generated by the top 10 products.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT SUM(TotalRevenue) AS TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10)

sql_queries.title: Revenue by Product Category
sql_queries.description: Shows the distribution of revenue among different product categories.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryID

sql_queries.title: Monthly Revenue Trend
sql_queries.description: Tracks the revenue trend of the top 10 products over the last 12 months.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS MonthlyRevenue FROM Orders o JOIN `Order Details` od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE p.ProductID IN (SELECT p.ProductID FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 10) AND o.OrderDate >= date('now', '-12 months') GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Units Sold by Product
sql_queries.description: Displays the number of units sold for each of the top 10 products.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Average Order Value
sql_queries.description: Shows the average order value for orders containing the top 10 products.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT AVG(OrderValue) AS AverageOrderValue FROM (SELECT o.OrderID, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS OrderValue FROM Orders o JOIN `Order Details` od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE od.ProductID IN (SELECT p.ProductID FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY o.OrderID)

sql_queries.title: Customer Demographics
sql_queries.description: Displays aggregated customer demographics for purchasers of the top 10 products.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT cd.CustomerDesc, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS NumberOfCustomers FROM Orders o JOIN `Order Details` od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN CustomerCustomerDemo ccd ON c.CustomerID = ccd.CustomerID JOIN CustomerDemographics cd ON ccd.CustomerTypeID = cd.CustomerTypeID WHERE od.ProductID IN (SELECT p.ProductID FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY cd.CustomerDesc

sql_queries.title: Sales by Region
sql_queries.description: Visualizes sales distribution of the top 10 products across different regions.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.Region, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales FROM Orders o JOIN `Order Details` od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID WHERE od.ProductID IN (SELECT p.ProductID FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY e.Region

sql_queries.title: Top Suppliers for Products
sql_queries.description: Lists the top suppliers for the products in the top 10 by revenue.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Suppliers s ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID WHERE p.ProductID IN (SELECT p.ProductID FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY s.SupplierID, p.ProductID ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC

sql_queries.title: Shipping Performance
sql_queries.description: Displays average shipping time for orders containing the top 10 products.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(o.ShippedDate) - julianday(o.OrderDate)) AS AverageShippingTime FROM Orders o JOIN `Order Details` od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE od.ProductID IN (SELECT p.ProductID FROM `Order Details` od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 10) AND o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL
